title: Aura-Farm
tagline: AuraFarm:  Personalized DeFi yields optimized for YOUR risk tolerance.
description:
Most DeFi platforms offer one strategy for everyone. Same allocation. Same risk level. When LUNA crashed in 2022, conservative investors and aggressive traders lost everything together—forced into risk they never signed up for. DeFi isn't broken. It's just never been personal.

Aura Farm changes that with soulbound Risk NFTs. New users complete a short AI-generated risk assessment—simple questions about real situations, no finance jargon. Our AI analyzes responses and mints a non-transferable NFT encoding your unique allocation strategy: maybe 20% Conservative, 30% Balanced, 50% Aggressive. Or 60/30/10 if you're cautious. Your profile. Your percentages.

Every deposit automatically splits according to your NFT across three ERC-4626 vault tiers. Conservative vaults hold stable protocols like Aave. Balanced vaults diversify across Yearn and similar platforms. Aggressive vaults pursue leveraged strategies. Safer capital stays safer. Higher-risk exposure is deliberate, not accidental.

Built on Arc testnet with Circle Gateway integration, cross-chain deposits are seamless. Deposit USDC from Sepolia, Ethereum, Base, or Optimism—Circle Gateway mints native USDC on Arc and routes it into your vaults automatically. No manual bridging. No wrapped tokens. Just simplified UX.

Markets change. Your portfolio adapts. Our AI engine continuously monitors APY performance, calculates Sharpe ratios, and detects underperformance across 9+ strategies. AI health checks flag weak strategies and trigger rebalancing to keep things safe. AI-powered performance rebalancing fine-tunes allocations based on real-time data, not fixed rules.

Rebalancing executes through Nitrolite Protocol. When triggered—by AI or manually—Nitrolite bundles complex operations into one seamless on-chain settlement: withdrawing from old strategies, reallocating based on your Risk NFT, depositing into optimized vaults. One click. Complete rebalancing.

Your dashboard shows real-time balance, live APY tracking, and profit/loss by vault. See exactly where every dollar works. Rebalance anytime. Withdraw anytime—partial or full.
Your risk. Your yield. Your Aura.
how_its_made:
Aura farm runs on Circle's Arc testnet with native USDC support. Built with Solidity and Foundry.
Circle Gateway Integration: Users deposit USDC from Ethereum, Sepolia, Base, etc directly into their Gateway Wallet. Circle Gateway mints native USDC on Arc and auto-routes it to VaultRouter based on the user's Risk NFT. No manual bridging, no wrapped tokens but seamless UX.

Soulbound Risk NFTs: Users complete a 4-question assessment. Generative AI analyzes responses and calculates personalized allocations (e.g., 40/40/20). These percentages are encoded on-chain in an ERC-721 soulbound NFT using pure Solidity—no IPFS dependencies.
ERC-4626 Vaults & Strategies: Three vaults (Conservative, Balanced, Aggressive) each allocate to their native ERC4626  strategies across Aave, Compound,  Lending , and custom yield sources. VaultRouter automatically splits deposits based on NFT percentages.

Nitrolite Protocol:  Generative AI monitors APY, volatility, and Sharpe ratios every 10 minutes, signs optimal allocations off-chain, and settles on-chain when profitable this happens with EIP712 on-chain verification.

AI Health Monitoring: GenAI validates strategy safety continuously, flagging weak performance and triggering emergency rebalancing.
